18-collapsible-tree-search.visual_critic_note: Deliberate Paul Tol palette and monospace count badges show real design intent, but the tree occupies only the top half of the viewport leaving large dead whitespace, and there is no in-visualization title — competent and considered but not yet polished.
18-collapsible-tree-search.encoding_integrity_note: Tree uses structural/categorical encoding only (no quantitative scales subject to baseline or lie-factor rules); color correctly encodes nominal rank, collapsed-count labels are computed from real descendant traversal, and SVG dimensions are data-driven via d3.extent/d3.max — minor robustness risk from name+depth composite keys instead of stable IDs, but inconsequential for unique taxonomy names.
18-collapsible-tree-search.stress_test_note: No .interrupt() call before starting new 500ms transitions means rapid node clicks during animation will stack transitions and cause jumping/NaN positions; search is properly debounced at 200ms, pointer events unify mouse/touch correctly, and the single-view design avoids feedback loops and stale scale issues.
18-collapsible-tree-search.cognitive_load_note: Progressive disclosure (collapse by default, +N badges, search-to-expand) keeps the ~200-node tree manageable at any given view; 6-color rank legend is within perceptual limits and consistently applied, so the default two-level state reads cleanly with no overload.
